- Per-namespace ConfigMap-driven versioning
- Sidecar-based request rewriting

```javascript
// Simplified path rewrite (pseudo)
const tenant = req.headers['x-tenant-id'];

proxyRequest.path = rewritten;
```

## Why This Is Asked

```yaml
# Minimal ImagePolicyWebhook-ish configuration (conceptual)
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingWebhookConfiguration
metadata:
  name: image-provenance
webhooks:
- name: image-provenance.example.com
  clientConfig:
    service:
      name: image-policy
      namespace: image-policy
      path: "/validate"
  rules:
  - apiGroups: ["apps"]
    apiVersions: ["v1"]
    operations: ["CREATE"]
    resources: ["deployments"]

```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests resilience isolation, tenant RBAC, and end-to-end chaos execution in CNF gateways. Demands practical familiarity with LitmusChaos, CRDs, and debugging cross-tenant faults.

## Key Concepts
- Namespace isolation and RBAC for chaos tooling
- ChaosExperiment and ChaosEngine CRDs
- Label-based target selection and end-to-end validation

## Code Example
```yaml
# RBAC: Tenant isolation for chaos tooling
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: tenant-chaos-admin
  namespace: tenant-ns
rules:
- apiGroups: ["litmuschaos.io"]
  resources: ["chaosexperiments","chaosexperiments/status","chaosengines","chaosengines/status"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch","create","delete","patch","update"]
```
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: tenant-chaos-admin-binding
  namespace: tenant-ns
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: chaos-sa
  namespace: tenant-ns
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: tenant-chaos-admin
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
```yaml
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosExperiment
metadata:
  name: cpu-stress
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  definition:
    image: litmuschaos/cpu-chaos:latest
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    args:
      - "-cpu-cores=1"
      - "-duration=30s"
```
```yaml
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosEngine
metadata:
  name: cpu-stress-engine
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  chaosServiceAccount: chaos-sa
  experiments:
  - name: cpu-stress
```
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gw
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: cnf-gw
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cnf-gw
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: your-org/cnf-gw:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosEngine
metadata:
  name: test-engine
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  chaosServiceAccount: chaos-sa
  experiments:
  - name: cpu-stress
```

```yaml
  replicas: 2
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: cnf
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
      - setWeight: 10
      - pause: { duration: 300s }
```

```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout-tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
      tenant: a
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
        tenant: a
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: registry.example.com/cnf/gateway:latest
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
      - setWeight: 10
      - pause: { duration: 5m }
      - setWeight: 100
      analysis:
        templates:
        - templateName: canary-metrics
        metrics:
        - name: latency
          interval: 30s
          successCondition: result < 0.001 * 0.15
        - name: error-rate
          interval: 30s
          successCondition: result < 0.005
```

```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AnalysisTemplate
metadata:
  name: canary-metrics
spec:
  metrics:
  - name: latency
    provider:
      prometheus:
        url: http://prometheus.k8s.svc
        query: sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_sum[5m])) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]))
  - name: error-rate
    provider:
      prometheus:
        url: http://prometheus.k8s.svc
        query: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status!~"2.."}[5m]))
```
